cohort.goldReadFrom: previous frozen paired audit; unchanged canonical Gold hashes recorded there

interpretation.boundaryClass: last Gold part to immediate next source atom
interpretation.negativeControls: the next one or two source edges after each Gold exit; controls are local adjacency observations, not extra independent heading examples
interpretation.descriptiveOnly: feature overlap on this development cohort is not a causal or held-out qualification result
interpretation.availableGeometry: live parser lines provide page, bounding box, font identity and parser layout-block membership; canonical snapshots used for requests do not retain the full PdfLine/glyph map
